title: Two deceased individuals in Rogers shooting, were teens, police confirm - NewsBreak
text:
By Edward McKinnon ,
1 days ago
ROGERS, Ark. (KNWA/KFTA) — A shooting left two teenagers dead in a Rogers neighborhood Monday night, while an individual believed to be involved in the shooting was interviewed and subsequently released, Rogers police confirmed on Tuesday.
The Rogers Police Department provided additional details about the shooting Tuesday afternoon after previously confirming a shooting investigation was in progress Monday night.
At approximately 8:19 p.m., Rogers police officers were dispatched to the 300 block of E Southern Trace Drive regarding a shooting incident. Police arrived shortly after the shooting and located two deceased 16-year-old males, according to a Tuesday news release.
Former University of Arkansas police officer accused of possessing CSAM Officers also located a 22-year-old male believed to be involved in the shooting, who immediately surrendered and was taken into custody without incident, according to the release. He was interviewed by investigators before being released.
Investigators determined the shooting was the result of a disturbance and was an "isolated incident," the release states. Police say there is no threat to the public at this time.
Police are currently consulting with the Benton County Prosecutor’s Office regarding the incident and whether criminal charges are appropriate, the release states.
The investigation remains ongoing, and additional information will be released as it becomes available and does not compromise the investigation, the release states.
